lines: I wanna fly so high
Yeah, I know my wings are dried
"Look up to your wings," people say
Beyond them lies only heartlessness
Some can fly, some fall
No one is watching
No one cares
And still I kept on flying
Carrying wounded words
Because I want to deliver them
Chasing after them, so they arrive
We beat our wings with all our hearts
Nights of asking and grieving
Made our homeland shine all the more
Like a migratory bird, I set out on my journey now
A story that doesn't exist
I'll go and draw it for you
I wanna fly so far
Away with my guitar
"You're not alone," people sing
It's not wrong
It's not empty idealism either
I just don't want to live leaning on someone
No one is listening
No one cares
And still I kept on singing
Because I want to make you
You, who've been hurt, laugh
I'll bring you a tailwind
We beat our wings with all our hearts
Carrying a distant past on our backs
I'll carry you to the future
Like migratory birds, we flock together now
Until the day we finish playing our audacious quartet
All this time we come and we grow
Now it's time that we should go
But we both know that this is for sure
It's not the end of the world
Well, see you one day
Chasing after them, so they arrive
We beat our wings with all our hearts
Nights of asking and grieving
Are dyed in the colors of dawn
Like a migratory bird, I'll circle back someday
A story that doesn't exist
Until the day we meet again
